// Live token prices from the FinOps hub price sheet, normalized per 1,000,000 tokens.
// Meter grammar: "<model> <ShortCo|LongCo> <Cd Inp|Cd Wr|Inp|Opt> <Std|PP> <Gl|DZ> 1M Tokens".
//   Inp = uncached input (i), Cd Inp = cached read (cr), Cd Wr = cache write (cw), Opt = output (o).
// Unprefixed fields are contracted rates; l-prefixed are list rates, used for negotiated discount.
// Prices are global to the billing account, so no subscription or resource scope filter applies.
// Set the "Cluster URI" and "Database" variables to point at your hub.
let meterRx = @"^(.+?) (ShortCo|LongCo) (Cd Inp|Cd Wr|Inp|Opt) (Std|PP) (Gl|DZ) 1M Tokens$";
// Read the deployment tier and scope from the meters the hub actually billed, per
// model, so neither is assumed. A model billed on priority processing or in a data
// zone is priced on its own meter rather than the standard global one.
let billedCombos = materialize(
    adx('${cluster}/${database}').Costs
    | where SkuMeter endswith "1M Tokens"
    | extend Model = strcat("gpt-", replace_string(extract(meterRx, 1, SkuMeter), " ", "-")),
             Tier = extract(meterRx, 4, SkuMeter),
             Scope = extract(meterRx, 5, SkuMeter)
    | where isnotempty(Tier) and isnotempty(Scope)
    | summarize Spend = sum(BilledCost) by Model, Tier, Scope
    | summarize arg_max(Spend, Tier, Scope) by Model
    | project Model, Tier, Scope
);
let priceRows = materialize(
    adx('${cluster}/${database}').Prices
    | where SkuMeter endswith "1M Tokens" and PricingUnit == "Units"
    | where isnotnull(x_PricingBlockSize) and x_PricingBlockSize > 0
    | extend Tier = extract(meterRx, 4, SkuMeter), Scope = extract(meterRx, 5, SkuMeter)
    | extend Model = strcat("gpt-", replace_string(extract(meterRx, 1, SkuMeter), " ", "-")),
             Context = iff(extract(meterRx, 2, SkuMeter) == "LongCo", "long", "short"),
             Op = extract(meterRx, 3, SkuMeter)
    | join kind=inner billedCombos on Model, Tier, Scope
    | where x_EffectivePeriodStart <= now()
    | extend C = todouble(ContractedUnitPrice) / x_PricingBlockSize * 1000000.0,
             L = todouble(iff(isnull(ListUnitPrice) or ListUnitPrice <= 0, ContractedUnitPrice, ListUnitPrice)) / x_PricingBlockSize * 1000000.0
    | summarize C = max(C), L = max(L), IngestedAt = max(x_IngestionTime), Currency = take_any(PricingCurrency)
      by Model, Context, Op, x_EffectivePeriodStart, x_EffectivePeriodEnd
    | summarize arg_max(x_EffectivePeriodStart, *) by Model, Context, Op
    | summarize i = round(maxif(C, Op == "Inp"), 8), cr = round(maxif(C, Op == "Cd Inp"), 8),
                cw = round(maxif(C, Op == "Cd Wr"), 8), o = round(maxif(C, Op == "Opt"), 8),
                li = round(maxif(L, Op == "Inp"), 8), lcr = round(maxif(L, Op == "Cd Inp"), 8),
                lcw = round(maxif(L, Op == "Cd Wr"), 8), lo = round(maxif(L, Op == "Opt"), 8),
                pStart = min(x_EffectivePeriodStart), pEnd = max(x_EffectivePeriodEnd), ops = dcount(Op),
                pIngest = max(IngestedAt), pCur = take_any(Currency)
      by Model, Context
    | where ops == 4);
let price = toscalar(priceRows
    | extend ctx = bag_pack(Context, bag_pack("i", i, "cr", cr, "cw", cw, "o", o, "li", li, "lcr", lcr, "lcw", lcw, "lo", lo))
    | summarize ctxBag = make_bag(ctx) by Model
    | extend m = bag_pack(Model, ctxBag)
    | summarize b = make_bag(m) | project b);
let priceStart = toscalar(priceRows | summarize max(pStart));
let priceEnd = toscalar(priceRows | summarize min(pEnd));
let priceRowCount = toscalar(priceRows | count);
let priceIngested = toscalar(priceRows | summarize max(pIngest));
let priceCurrency = toscalar(priceRows | summarize take_any(pCur));
let pricesLoaded = priceRowCount > 0;
let spans = materialize(dependencies
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName in ('codex-app-server', 'coding-agent.codex-app-server', '[coding-agent]/codex-app-server')
| where name in ('session_task.turn', 'session_task.run', 'run_turn', 'run_sampling_request', 'try_run_sampling_request', 'receiving_stream', 'handle_responses')
| where name != 'handle_responses' or isnotnull(todouble(customDimensions['codex.usage.total_tokens']))
| summarize take_any(timestamp, name, operation_ParentId, customDimensions, duration) by cloud_RoleName, operation_Id, id);
let turns = spans
| where name == 'session_task.turn'
| project cloud_RoleName, operation_Id, turnSpanId = id, turnStarted = timestamp, duration_s = duration / 1000.0,
          turnModel = tostring(customDimensions['model']), thread = tostring(customDimensions['thread.id']), turn = tostring(customDimensions['turn.id']),
          turnInput = todouble(customDimensions['codex.turn.token_usage.input_tokens']),
          turnCached = todouble(customDimensions['codex.turn.token_usage.cached_input_tokens']),
          turnWritten = todouble(customDimensions['codex.turn.token_usage.cache_write_input_tokens']),
          turnOutput = todouble(customDimensions['codex.turn.token_usage.output_tokens']),
          turnTotal = todouble(customDimensions['codex.turn.token_usage.total_tokens']);
let responseUsage = spans
| where name == 'handle_responses'
| extend total = todouble(customDimensions['codex.usage.total_tokens']),
         input = todouble(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens']),
         cached = todouble(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens']),
         written = todouble(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.cache_write.input_tokens']),
         output = todouble(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens']),
         streamId = operation_ParentId
| lookup kind=leftouter (spans | where name == 'receiving_stream'
    | project cloud_RoleName, operation_Id, streamId = id, samplingId = operation_ParentId) on cloud_RoleName, operation_Id, streamId
| lookup kind=leftouter (spans | where name == 'try_run_sampling_request'
    | project cloud_RoleName, operation_Id, samplingId = id, requestId = operation_ParentId, model = tostring(customDimensions['model'])) on cloud_RoleName, operation_Id, samplingId
| extend context = iff(input > 272000, 'long', 'short')
| extend p = price[model][context], shortPrice = price[model]['short'];
// Cache-write pricing replaces ordinary input pricing for the same tokens.
// https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/prompt-caching#monitor-cache-performance
// An absent exported write counter is unknown, not zero (Codex 0.142.0 does not emit it).
let responseCosts = materialize(responseUsage
| extend coreUsageValid = coalesce(total >= 0 and input >= 0 and cached >= 0 and cached <= input
    and output >= 0 and total == input + output, false),
         priceValid = pricesLoaded and isnotnull(p) and timestamp >= priceStart and timestamp < priceEnd
| extend priceStatus = case(not(pricesLoaded), 'Price data unavailable',
                            isempty(model), 'BUG: Missing response model',
                            isnull(p), 'BUG: Model missing from price map',
                            timestamp < priceStart or timestamp >= priceEnd, 'Price outside effective period',
                            not(coreUsageValid), 'Invalid or missing token usage',
                            isnull(written), 'Cache-write counter missing',
                            written < 0 or cached + written > input, 'Invalid cache partition',
                            'Priced'),
         uncached = input - cached - written
| extend input_cost_usd = iff(priceStatus == 'Priced', uncached * todouble(p.i) / 1000000.0, real(null)),
         cached_cost_usd = iff(priceValid and coreUsageValid, cached * todouble(p.cr) / 1000000.0, real(null)),
         write_cost_usd = iff(priceStatus == 'Priced', written * todouble(p.cw) / 1000000.0, real(null)),
         output_cost_usd = iff(priceValid and coreUsageValid, output * todouble(p.o) / 1000000.0, real(null)),
         retail_usd = iff(priceStatus == 'Priced',
             (uncached * todouble(p.li) + cached * todouble(p.lcr) + written * todouble(p.lcw) + output * todouble(p.lo)) / 1000000.0, real(null)),
         cache_benefit_usd = iff(priceStatus == 'Priced',
             (cached * (todouble(p.i) - todouble(p.cr)) - written * (todouble(p.cw) - todouble(p.i))) / 1000000.0, real(null)),
         context_premium_usd = iff(priceStatus == 'Priced',
             (uncached * (todouble(p.i) - todouble(shortPrice.i)) + cached * (todouble(p.cr) - todouble(shortPrice.cr))
              + written * (todouble(p.cw) - todouble(shortPrice.cw)) + output * (todouble(p.o) - todouble(shortPrice.o))) / 1000000.0, real(null)),
         negotiated_discount_usd = iff(priceStatus == 'Priced',
             (uncached * (todouble(p.li) - todouble(p.i)) + cached * (todouble(p.lcr) - todouble(p.cr))
              + written * (todouble(p.lcw) - todouble(p.cw)) + output * (todouble(p.lo) - todouble(p.o))) / 1000000.0, real(null))
| extend cost_usd = input_cost_usd + cached_cost_usd + write_cost_usd + output_cost_usd
);

responseCosts
| where priceStatus == 'Priced'
| summarize reports = count(), cost = sum(cost_usd), tokens = sum(total),
            benefit = sum(cache_benefit_usd),
            inputCost = sum(input_cost_usd), inputTokens = sum(uncached),
            readCost = sum(cached_cost_usd), readTokens = sum(cached),
            writeCost = sum(write_cost_usd), writeTokens = sum(written),
            outputCost = sum(output_cost_usd), outputTokens = sum(output)
| project value = iff(reports > 0, cost, real(null))

//   Inp = uncached input (i), Cd Inp = cached read (cr), Cd Wr = cache write (cw), Opt = output (o).
// Unprefixed fields are contracted rates; l-prefixed are list rates, used for negotiated discount.
// Prices are global to the billing account, so no subscription or resource scope filter applies.
// Set the "Cluster URI" and "Database" variables to point at your hub.
let meterRx = @"^(.+?) (ShortCo|LongCo) (Cd Inp|Cd Wr|Inp|Opt) (Std|PP) (Gl|DZ) 1M Tokens$";
// Read the deployment tier and scope from the meters the hub actually billed, per
// model, so neither is assumed. A model billed on priority processing or in a data
// zone is priced on its own meter rather than the standard global one.
let billedCombos = materialize(
    adx('${cluster}/${database}').Costs
    | where SkuMeter endswith "1M Tokens"
    | extend Model = strcat("gpt-", replace_string(extract(meterRx, 1, SkuMeter), " ", "-")),
             Tier = extract(meterRx, 4, SkuMeter),
             Scope = extract(meterRx, 5, SkuMeter)
    | where isnotempty(Tier) and isnotempty(Scope)
    | summarize Spend = sum(BilledCost) by Model, Tier, Scope
    | summarize arg_max(Spend, Tier, Scope) by Model
    | project Model, Tier, Scope
);
let priceRows = materialize(
    adx('${cluster}/${database}').Prices
    | where SkuMeter endswith "1M Tokens" and PricingUnit == "Units"
    | where isnotnull(x_PricingBlockSize) and x_PricingBlockSize > 0
    | extend Tier = extract(meterRx, 4, SkuMeter), Scope = extract(meterRx, 5, SkuMeter)
    | extend Model = strcat("gpt-", replace_string(extract(meterRx, 1, SkuMeter), " ", "-")),
             Context = iff(extract(meterRx, 2, SkuMeter) == "LongCo", "long", "short"),
             Op = extract(meterRx, 3, SkuMeter)
    | join kind=inner billedCombos on Model, Tier, Scope
    | where x_EffectivePeriodStart <= now()
    | extend C = todouble(ContractedUnitPrice) / x_PricingBlockSize * 1000000.0,
             L = todouble(iff(isnull(ListUnitPrice) or ListUnitPrice <= 0, ContractedUnitPrice, ListUnitPrice)) / x_PricingBlockSize * 1000000.0
    | summarize C = max(C), L = max(L), IngestedAt = max(x_IngestionTime), Currency = take_any(PricingCurrency)
      by Model, Context, Op, x_EffectivePeriodStart, x_EffectivePeriodEnd
    | summarize arg_max(x_EffectivePeriodStart, *) by Model, Context, Op
    | summarize i = round(maxif(C, Op == "Inp"), 8), cr = round(maxif(C, Op == "Cd Inp"), 8),
                cw = round(maxif(C, Op == "Cd Wr"), 8), o = round(maxif(C, Op == "Opt"), 8),
                li = round(maxif(L, Op == "Inp"), 8), lcr = round(maxif(L, Op == "Cd Inp"), 8),
                lcw = round(maxif(L, Op == "Cd Wr"), 8), lo = round(maxif(L, Op == "Opt"), 8),
                pStart = min(x_EffectivePeriodStart), pEnd = max(x_EffectivePeriodEnd), ops = dcount(Op),
                pIngest = max(IngestedAt), pCur = take_any(Currency)
      by Model, Context
    | where ops == 4);
let price = toscalar(priceRows
    | extend ctx = bag_pack(Context, bag_pack("i", i, "cr", cr, "cw", cw, "o", o, "li", li, "lcr", lcr, "lcw", lcw, "lo", lo))
    | summarize ctxBag = make_bag(ctx) by Model
    | extend m = bag_pack(Model, ctxBag)
    | summarize b = make_bag(m) | project b);
let priceStart = toscalar(priceRows | summarize max(pStart));
let priceEnd = toscalar(priceRows | summarize min(pEnd));
let priceRowCount = toscalar(priceRows | count);
let priceIngested = toscalar(priceRows | summarize max(pIngest));
let priceCurrency = toscalar(priceRows | summarize take_any(pCur));
let pricesLoaded = priceRowCount > 0;
let spans = materialize(dependencies
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName in ('codex-app-server', 'coding-agent.codex-app-server', '[coding-agent]/codex-app-server')
| where name in ('session_task.turn', 'session_task.run', 'run_turn', 'run_sampling_request', 'try_run_sampling_request', 'receiving_stream', 'handle_responses')
| where name != 'handle_responses' or isnotnull(todouble(customDimensions['codex.usage.total_tokens']))
| summarize take_any(timestamp, name, operation_ParentId, customDimensions, duration) by cloud_RoleName, operation_Id, id);

| where name == 'session_task.turn'
| project cloud_RoleName, operation_Id, turnSpanId = id, turnStarted = timestamp, duration_s = duration / 1000.0,
          turnModel = tostring(customDimensions['model']), thread = tostring(customDimensions['thread.id']), turn = tostring(customDimensions['turn.id']),
          turnInput = todouble(customDimensions['codex.turn.token_usage.input_tokens']),
          turnCached = todouble(customDimensions['codex.turn.token_usage.cached_input_tokens']),
          turnWritten = todouble(customDimensions['codex.turn.token_usage.cache_write_input_tokens']),
          turnOutput = todouble(customDimensions['codex.turn.token_usage.output_tokens']),
          turnTotal = todouble(customDimensions['codex.turn.token_usage.total_tokens']);
let responseUsage = spans
| where name == 'handle_responses'
| extend total = todouble(customDimensions['codex.usage.total_tokens']),
         input = todouble(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens']),
         cached = todouble(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens']),
         written = todouble(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.cache_write.input_tokens']),
         output = todouble(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens']),
         streamId = operation_ParentId
| lookup kind=leftouter (spans | where name == 'receiving_stream'
    | project cloud_RoleName, operation_Id, streamId = id, samplingId = operation_ParentId) on cloud_RoleName, operation_Id, streamId
| lookup kind=leftouter (spans | where name == 'try_run_sampling_request'
    | project cloud_RoleName, operation_Id, samplingId = id, requestId = operation_ParentId, model = tostring(customDimensions['model'])) on cloud_RoleName, operation_Id, samplingId
| extend context = iff(input > 272000, 'long', 'short')
| extend p = price[model][context], shortPrice = price[model]['short'];
// Cache-write pricing replaces ordinary input pricing for the same tokens.
// https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/prompt-caching#monitor-cache-performance
// An absent exported write counter is unknown, not zero (Codex 0.142.0 does not emit it).
let responseCosts = materialize(responseUsage
| extend coreUsageValid = coalesce(total >= 0 and input >= 0 and cached >= 0 and cached <= input
    and output >= 0 and total == input + output, false),
         priceValid = pricesLoaded and isnotnull(p) and timestamp >= priceStart and timestamp < priceEnd
| extend priceStatus = case(not(pricesLoaded), 'Price data unavailable',
                            isempty(model), 'BUG: Missing response model',
                            isnull(p), 'BUG: Model missing from price map',
                            timestamp < priceStart or timestamp >= priceEnd, 'Price outside effective period',
                            not(coreUsageValid), 'Invalid or missing token usage',
                            isnull(written), 'Cache-write counter missing',
                            written < 0 or cached + written > input, 'Invalid cache partition',
                            'Priced'),
         uncached = input - cached - written
| extend input_cost_usd = iff(priceStatus == 'Priced', uncached * todouble(p.i) / 1000000.0, real(null)),
         cached_cost_usd = iff(priceValid and coreUsageValid, cached * todouble(p.cr) / 1000000.0, real(null)),
         write_cost_usd = iff(priceStatus == 'Priced', written * todouble(p.cw) / 1000000.0, real(null)),
         output_cost_usd = iff(priceValid and coreUsageValid, output * todouble(p.o) / 1000000.0, real(null)),
         retail_usd = iff(priceStatus == 'Priced',
             (uncached * todouble(p.li) + cached * todouble(p.lcr) + written * todouble(p.lcw) + output * todouble(p.lo)) / 1000000.0, real(null)),
         cache_benefit_usd = iff(priceStatus == 'Priced',
             (cached * (todouble(p.i) - todouble(p.cr)) - written * (todouble(p.cw) - todouble(p.i))) / 1000000.0, real(null)),
         context_premium_usd = iff(priceStatus == 'Priced',
             (uncached * (todouble(p.i) - todouble(shortPrice.i)) + cached * (todouble(p.cr) - todouble(shortPrice.cr))
              + written * (todouble(p.cw) - todouble(shortPrice.cw)) + output * (todouble(p.o) - todouble(shortPrice.o))) / 1000000.0, real(null)),
         negotiated_discount_usd = iff(priceStatus == 'Priced',
             (uncached * (todouble(p.li) - todouble(p.i)) + cached * (todouble(p.lcr) - todouble(p.cr))
              + written * (todouble(p.lcw) - todouble(p.cw)) + output * (todouble(p.lo) - todouble(p.o))) / 1000000.0, real(null))
| extend cost_usd = input_cost_usd + cached_cost_usd + write_cost_usd + output_cost_usd

let priceEnd = toscalar(priceRows | summarize min(pEnd));
let priceRowCount = toscalar(priceRows | count);
let priceIngested = toscalar(priceRows | summarize max(pIngest));
let priceCurrency = toscalar(priceRows | summarize take_any(pCur));
let pricesLoaded = priceRowCount > 0;
let spans = materialize(dependencies
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName in ('codex-app-server', 'coding-agent.codex-app-server', '[coding-agent]/codex-app-server')
| where name in ('session_task.turn', 'session_task.run', 'run_turn', 'run_sampling_request', 'try_run_sampling_request', 'receiving_stream', 'handle_responses')
| where name != 'handle_responses' or isnotnull(todouble(customDimensions['codex.usage.total_tokens']))
| summarize take_any(timestamp, name, operation_ParentId, customDimensions, duration) by cloud_RoleName, operation_Id, id);
let turns = spans
| where name == 'session_task.turn'
| project cloud_RoleName, operation_Id, turnSpanId = id, turnStarted = timestamp, duration_s = duration / 1000.0,
          turnModel = tostring(customDimensions['model']), thread = tostring(customDimensions['thread.id']), turn = tostring(customDimensions['turn.id']),
          turnInput = todouble(customDimensions['codex.turn.token_usage.input_tokens']),
          turnCached = todouble(customDimensions['codex.turn.token_usage.cached_input_tokens']),
          turnWritten = todouble(customDimensions['codex.turn.token_usage.cache_write_input_tokens']),
          turnOutput = todouble(customDimensions['codex.turn.token_usage.output_tokens']),
          turnTotal = todouble(customDimensions['codex.turn.token_usage.total_tokens']);
let responseUsage = spans
| where name == 'handle_responses'
| extend total = todouble(customDimensions['codex.usage.total_tokens']),
         input = todouble(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens']),
         cached = todouble(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens']),
         written = todouble(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.cache_write.input_tokens']),
         output = todouble(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens']),
         streamId = operation_ParentId
| lookup kind=leftouter (spans | where name == 'receiving_stream'
    | project cloud_RoleName, operation_Id, streamId = id, samplingId = operation_ParentId) on cloud_RoleName, operation_Id, streamId
| lookup kind=leftouter (spans | where name == 'try_run_sampling_request'
    | project cloud_RoleName, operation_Id, samplingId = id, requestId = operation_ParentId, model = tostring(customDimensions['model'])) on cloud_RoleName, operation_Id, samplingId
| extend context = iff(input > 272000, 'long', 'short')
| extend p = price[model][context], shortPrice = price[model]['short'];
// Cache-write pricing replaces ordinary input pricing for the same tokens.
// https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/prompt-caching#monitor-cache-performance
// An absent exported write counter is unknown, not zero (Codex 0.142.0 does not emit it).
let responseCosts = materialize(responseUsage
| extend coreUsageValid = coalesce(total >= 0 and input >= 0 and cached >= 0 and cached <= input
    and output >= 0 and total == input + output, false),
         priceValid = pricesLoaded and isnotnull(p) and timestamp >= priceStart and timestamp < priceEnd
| extend priceStatus = case(not(pricesLoaded), 'Price data unavailable',
                            isempty(model), 'BUG: Missing response model',
                            isnull(p), 'BUG: Model missing from price map',
                            timestamp < priceStart or timestamp >= priceEnd, 'Price outside effective period',
                            not(coreUsageValid), 'Invalid or missing token usage',
                            isnull(written), 'Cache-write counter missing',
                            written < 0 or cached + written > input, 'Invalid cache partition',
                            'Priced'),
         uncached = input - cached - written
| extend input_cost_usd = iff(priceStatus == 'Priced', uncached * todouble(p.i) / 1000000.0, real(null)),
         cached_cost_usd = iff(priceValid and coreUsageValid, cached * todouble(p.cr) / 1000000.0, real(null)),
         write_cost_usd = iff(priceStatus == 'Priced', written * todouble(p.cw) / 1000000.0, real(null)),
         output_cost_usd = iff(priceValid and coreUsageValid, output * todouble(p.o) / 1000000.0, real(null)),
         retail_usd = iff(priceStatus == 'Priced',
             (uncached * todouble(p.li) + cached * todouble(p.lcr) + written * todouble(p.lcw) + output * todouble(p.lo)) / 1000000.0, real(null)),
         cache_benefit_usd = iff(priceStatus == 'Priced',
             (cached * (todouble(p.i) - todouble(p.cr)) - written * (todouble(p.cw) - todouble(p.i))) / 1000000.0, real(null)),
         context_premium_usd = iff(priceStatus == 'Priced',
             (uncached * (todouble(p.i) - todouble(shortPrice.i)) + cached * (todouble(p.cr) - todouble(shortPrice.cr))
              + written * (todouble(p.cw) - todouble(shortPrice.cw)) + output * (todouble(p.o) - todouble(shortPrice.o))) / 1000000.0, real(null)),
         negotiated_discount_usd = iff(priceStatus == 'Priced',
             (uncached * (todouble(p.li) - todouble(p.i)) + cached * (todouble(p.lcr) - todouble(p.cr))
              + written * (todouble(p.lcw) - todouble(p.cw)) + output * (todouble(p.lo) - todouble(p.o))) / 1000000.0, real(null))
| extend cost_usd = input_cost_usd + cached_cost_usd + write_cost_usd + output_cost_usd
| lookup kind=leftouter (spans | where name == 'run_sampling_request'
    | project cloud_RoleName, operation_Id, requestId = id, runTurnId = operation_ParentId) on cloud_RoleName, operation_Id, requestId
| lookup kind=leftouter (spans | where name == 'run_turn'
    | project cloud_RoleName, operation_Id, runTurnId = id, taskRunId = operation_ParentId) on cloud_RoleName, operation_Id, runTurnId
| lookup kind=leftouter (spans | where name == 'session_task.run'
    | project cloud_RoleName, operation_Id, taskRunId = id, turnSpanId = operation_ParentId) on cloud_RoleName, operation_Id, taskRunId
| lookup kind=leftouter (turns | project cloud_RoleName, operation_Id, turnSpanId, turnPresent = true) on cloud_RoleName, operation_Id, turnSpanId);
let turnCosts = responseCosts
| where turnPresent == true
| summarize responses = count(), pricedResponses = countif(priceStatus == 'Priced'),
            responseInput = sum(input), responseCached = sum(cached), responseWritten = sum(written),
            responseOutput = sum(output), responseTotal = sum(total),
            cost_usd = sum(cost_usd), retail_usd = sum(retail_usd), negotiated_discount_usd = sum(negotiated_discount_usd),
            input_cost_usd = sum(input_cost_usd), cached_cost_usd = sum(cached_cost_usd),
            write_cost_usd = sum(write_cost_usd), output_cost_usd = sum(output_cost_usd),
            cache_benefit_usd = sum(cache_benefit_usd), context_premium_usd = sum(context_premium_usd),
            longResponses = countif(context == 'long'), maxResponseInput = max(input),
            responseIssues = make_set_if(priceStatus, priceStatus != 'Priced', 8)
    by cloud_RoleName, operation_Id, turnSpanId;
let pricedTurns = materialize(turns
| lookup kind=leftouter turnCosts on cloud_RoleName, operation_Id, turnSpanId
| extend pricingStatus = case(isnull(responses), 'No response usage in range',
                              isempty(turnModel), 'Missing turn model',
                              pricedResponses != responses, strcat_array(responseIssues, '; '),
                              isnull(turnTotal) or isnull(turnInput) or isnull(turnCached) or isnull(turnOutput), 'Turn summary missing',
                              responseInput != turnInput or responseCached != turnCached
                                  or responseOutput != turnOutput or responseTotal != turnTotal, 'Response and turn usage differ',
                              isnotnull(turnWritten) and responseWritten != turnWritten, 'Response and turn cache writes differ',
                              'Complete')
| extend complete = pricingStatus == 'Complete'
| extend cost_usd = iff(complete, cost_usd, real(null)),
         retail_usd = iff(complete, retail_usd, real(null)),
         negotiated_discount_usd = iff(complete, negotiated_discount_usd, real(null)),
         input_cost_usd = iff(complete, input_cost_usd, real(null)),
         cached_cost_usd = iff(complete, cached_cost_usd, real(null)),
         write_cost_usd = iff(complete, write_cost_usd, real(null)),
         output_cost_usd = iff(complete, output_cost_usd, real(null)),
         cache_benefit_usd = iff(complete, cache_benefit_usd, real(null)),
         context_premium_usd = iff(complete, context_premium_usd, real(null)));

pricedTurns
| summarize turns = count(), priced_turns = countif(complete), turns_with_tokens = countif(isnotnull(turnTotal)),
            total_tokens = sum(turnTotal), totalInput = sum(turnInput), totalCached = sum(turnCached),
            p95_s = percentile(duration_s, 95), cost_usd = sum(cost_usd), retail_usd = sum(retail_usd),
            negotiated_discount_usd = sum(negotiated_discount_usd), input_cost_usd = sum(input_cost_usd),
            cached_cost_usd = sum(cached_cost_usd), write_cost_usd = sum(write_cost_usd), output_cost_usd = sum(output_cost_usd),
            cache_benefit_usd = sum(cache_benefit_usd), context_premium_usd = sum(context_premium_usd),
            longResponses = sum(longResponses), maxResponseInput = max(maxResponseInput),
            issues = make_set_if(pricingStatus, not(complete), 8) by model = turnModel
| extend complete = priced_turns == turns, missing_usage = turns - turns_with_tokens,
         total_tokens = iff(turns_with_tokens > 0, total_tokens, real(null)),
         avg_per_turn = iff(turns_with_tokens > 0, total_tokens / turns_with_tokens, real(null)),
         cache_pct = iff(totalInput > 0, 100.0 * totalCached / totalInput, real(null)),
         pricing_coverage = 100.0 * priced_turns / turns
| extend pricingStatus = iff(complete, 'Complete', strcat(priced_turns, '/', turns, ' turns priced; ', strcat_array(issues, '; '))),
         cost_usd = iff(complete, cost_usd, real(null)), retail_usd = iff(complete, retail_usd, real(null)),
         negotiated_discount_usd = iff(complete, negotiated_discount_usd, real(null)),
         input_cost_usd = iff(complete, input_cost_usd, real(null)),
         cached_cost_usd = iff(complete, cached_cost_usd, real(null)),
         write_cost_usd = iff(complete, write_cost_usd, real(null)),
         output_cost_usd = iff(complete, output_cost_usd, real(null)),
         cache_benefit_usd = iff(complete, cache_benefit_usd, real(null)),
         context_premium_usd = iff(complete, context_premium_usd, real(null))
| extend cost_per_turn_usd = cost_usd / turns,
         negotiated_discount_pct = iff(retail_usd > 0, 100.0 * negotiated_discount_usd / retail_usd, real(null))
| project model, turns, pricingStatus, cost_usd, retail_usd, negotiated_discount_pct, cost_per_turn_usd, p95_s, pricing_coverage,
          input_cost_usd, cached_cost_usd, write_cost_usd, output_cost_usd, negotiated_discount_usd, cache_benefit_usd, context_premium_usd,
          longResponses, maxResponseInput, total_tokens, avg_per_turn, cache_pct, turns_with_tokens, missing_usage
| order by cost_usd desc nulls last

panels.description: Contracted and list USD estimates use response-level ordinary input, cache-read input, cache-write input, and output. Cache writes replace ordinary input pricing for the same tokens. Long context starts above 272,000 input tokens in one response. Missing write counters remain unknown, including older Codex versions that cannot export them. Response usage must reconcile with the completed-turn summary before a turn estimate is shown. Net cache benefit compares the same usage without caching against actual estimated cost, including write premiums. Context premium uses the same usage at short-context rates. These counterfactuals overlap and must not be added. Estimates are not billed or effective cost. Ranked by contracted estimate. Unpriced turns cannot be ranked by cost; the coverage table includes all incomplete turns. Full identities remain available by scrolling horizontally.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
// Live token prices from the FinOps hub price sheet, normalized per 1,000,000 tokens.
// Meter grammar: "<model> <ShortCo|LongCo> <Cd Inp|Cd Wr|Inp|Opt> <Std|PP> <Gl|DZ> 1M Tokens".
//   Inp = uncached input (i), Cd Inp = cached read (cr), Cd Wr = cache write (cw), Opt = output (o).
// Unprefixed fields are contracted rates; l-prefixed are list rates, used for negotiated discount.
// Prices are global to the billing account, so no subscription or resource scope filter applies.
// Set the "Cluster URI" and "Database" variables to point at your hub.
let meterRx = @"^(.+?) (ShortCo|LongCo) (Cd Inp|Cd Wr|Inp|Opt) (Std|PP) (Gl|DZ) 1M Tokens$";
// Read the deployment tier and scope from the meters the hub actually billed, per
// model, so neither is assumed. A model billed on priority processing or in a data
// zone is priced on its own meter rather than the standard global one.
let billedCombos = materialize(
    adx('${cluster}/${database}').Costs
    | where SkuMeter endswith "1M Tokens"

                              'Complete')
| extend complete = pricingStatus == 'Complete'
| extend cost_usd = iff(complete, cost_usd, real(null)),
         retail_usd = iff(complete, retail_usd, real(null)),
         negotiated_discount_usd = iff(complete, negotiated_discount_usd, real(null)),
         input_cost_usd = iff(complete, input_cost_usd, real(null)),
         cached_cost_usd = iff(complete, cached_cost_usd, real(null)),
         write_cost_usd = iff(complete, write_cost_usd, real(null)),
         output_cost_usd = iff(complete, output_cost_usd, real(null)),
         cache_benefit_usd = iff(complete, cache_benefit_usd, real(null)),
         context_premium_usd = iff(complete, context_premium_usd, real(null)));
let telemetryCoverage = (union
    (dependencies
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName in ('codex-app-server', 'coding-agent.codex-app-server', '[coding-agent]/codex-app-server')
| where name == 'session_init' | summarize records = count(), last_seen = max(timestamp) | extend signal = 'Session initializations', source = 'dependencies'),
    (dependencies
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName in ('codex-app-server', 'coding-agent.codex-app-server', '[coding-agent]/codex-app-server')
| where name == 'session_task.turn' | summarize records = count(), last_seen = max(timestamp) | extend signal = 'Completed turn spans', source = 'dependencies'),
    (dependencies
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName in ('codex-app-server', 'coding-agent.codex-app-server', '[coding-agent]/codex-app-server')
| where name == 'session_task.turn' | where isnotnull(todouble(customDimensions['codex.turn.token_usage.total_tokens']))
     | summarize records = count(), last_seen = max(timestamp) | extend signal = 'Turns with token usage', source = 'dependencies'),
    (dependencies
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName in ('codex-app-server', 'coding-agent.codex-app-server', '[coding-agent]/codex-app-server')
| where name == 'handle_responses'
| extend total = todouble(customDimensions['codex.usage.total_tokens']),
         input = todouble(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens']),
         cached = todouble(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens']),
         output = todouble(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens']),
         reasoning = todouble(customDimensions['codex.usage.reasoning_output_tokens'])
| where isnotnull(total) | summarize records = count(), last_seen = max(timestamp) | extend signal = 'Response token reports', source = 'dependencies'),
    (customMetrics
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName in ('codex-app-server', 'coding-agent.codex-app-server', '[coding-agent]/codex-app-server') | where name == 'codex.tool.call'
     | summarize records = count(), last_seen = max(timestamp) | extend signal = 'Tool-call metric points', source = 'customMetrics'),
    (traces
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName in ('codex-app-server', 'coding-agent.codex-app-server', '[coding-agent]/codex-app-server') | where tostring(customDimensions['event.name']) == 'codex.tool_result'
     | summarize records = count(), last_seen = max(timestamp) | extend signal = 'Tool-result logs (raw, before deduplication)', source = 'traces'),
    (requests
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName in ('codex-app-server', 'coding-agent.codex-app-server', '[coding-agent]/codex-app-server') | summarize records = count(), last_seen = max(timestamp) | extend signal = 'Application request spans', source = 'requests'),
    (dependencies
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName in ('codex-app-server', 'coding-agent.codex-app-server', '[coding-agent]/codex-app-server') | summarize records = count(), last_seen = max(timestamp) | extend signal = 'Application dependency spans', source = 'dependencies')
| extend age_s = todouble(datetime_diff('second', $__timeTo(), last_seen)),
         availability = iff(records > 0, 'Observed', 'Not observed in this resource/window')
| project signal, source, records, last_seen, age_s, availability
| order by signal asc);
let pricingCoverage = union
    (responseCosts
     | summarize observed = count(), records = countif(isnull(written)), last_seen = max(timestamp),
                 versions = make_set_if(tostring(customDimensions['service.version']), isnull(written), 8)
     | extend signal = 'Pricing: missing cache-write counters', source = 'dependencies',
              availability = case(observed == 0, 'No response usage', records == 0, 'All write counters present', 'Usage incomplete'),
              details = strcat(records, ' of ', observed, ' reports lack a write counter; client versions: ', tostring(versions))),
    (print signal = 'Pricing: price scope', source = 'Prices', records = priceRowCount, last_seen = priceIngested,
           availability = iff(pricesLoaded, 'Prices loaded', 'Price data unavailable'),
           details = strcat('Prices are global to the billing account; ', priceRowCount, ' model and context rates loaded from ', billedMeterScopes, ' meters')),
    (responseCosts
     | summarize records = count(), priced = countif(priceStatus == 'Priced'), knownCost = sum(cost_usd), last_seen = max(timestamp)
     | extend signal = 'Pricing: response coverage', source = 'dependencies',
              availability = case(records == 0, 'No response usage', records == priced, 'Complete', 'Incomplete'),
              details = iff(records == 0, 'No usage reported', strcat(priced, ' of ', records, ' usage reports priced; priced subtotal USD ', round(knownCost, 6), iff(priced == records, '', '; unpriced usage excluded from monetary KPIs')))),
    (responseCosts
     | summarize observed = count(), records = countif(priceStatus != 'Priced'), last_seen = max(timestamp),
                 problems = make_set_if(strcat(model, ': ', priceStatus), priceStatus != 'Priced')
     | extend signal = 'Pricing: response errors', source = 'dependencies',
              availability = case(observed == 0, 'No response usage', records == 0, 'No pricing errors', 'Action required'),
              details = tostring(problems)),
    (responseCosts
     | summarize observed = count(), records = countif(isnull(turnPresent)), last_seen = max(timestamp)
     | extend signal = 'Pricing: unattributed responses', source = 'dependencies',
              availability = case(observed == 0, 'No response usage', records == 0, 'All responses linked to turns', 'Action required'),
              details = 'Usage response -> stream -> sampling request -> run sampling -> run turn -> session task -> completed turn'),
    (pricedTurns
     | summarize observed = count(), records = countif(not(complete)), last_seen = max(turnStarted),
                 problems = make_set_if(pricingStatus, not(complete))
     | extend signal = 'Pricing: incomplete turns', source = 'dependencies',
              availability = case(observed == 0, 'No completed turns', records == 0, 'All turn usage reconciles', 'Action required'),
              details = tostring(problems)),
    (print signal = 'Pricing: effective period', source = 'Prices', records = priceRowCount, last_seen = priceIngested,
           availability = iff($__timeFrom() >= priceStart and $__timeTo() < priceEnd, 'Range covered', 'Range extends beyond price period'),
           details = strcat(priceCurrency, '; ', billedMeterScopes, '; ', priceStart, ' <= response time < ', priceEnd)),
    (print signal = 'Pricing: source', source = 'Prices', records = priceRowCount, last_seen = priceIngested,
           availability = iff(priceEnd <= now(), 'Price sheet expired; refresh hub price data', 'Live price sheet'),
           details = strcat('${cluster}/${database} Prices; ', priceCurrency, ' per million tokens = unit price * 1,000,000 / x_PricingBlockSize; writes replace ordinary input pricing; missing exported write counts stay unknown'))
| extend age_s = todouble(datetime_diff('second', $__timeTo(), last_seen));
union pricingCoverage, telemetryCoverage
| project signal, availability, records, details, source, last_seen, age_s
| order by signal asc
